We need propose a retrosynthesis route with 1 reaction to synthesize target SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O. This appears to be a methyl ester of a bicyclic ketone (maybe a bicyclo[4.4.0]dec-1-ene-2-one?). The hint suggests Diels-Alder reaction (retro-Diels-Alder) as the single step. So we need to propose precursors: a diene and a dienophile that undergo Diels-Alder to give the bicyclic product. The template ID 1914385 corresponds to a Diels-Alder retro (forward is Diels-Alder). The retro template splits product into diene and dienophile as shown in mapped reaction: product SMILES: [CH3][O][C](=O)[C@]12[CH2][CH]=[CH][CH2][C@H]1[C](=O)[CH2]2 (approx). Reactant SMILES: [CH2]=[CH][CH]=[CH2] (diene) and [CH3][O][C](=O)[C]1=[CH][C](=O)[CH2]1 (dienophile). So we can apply this template to our target to get precursors.

We need to construct JSON route: root molecule target, child reaction with template_id 1914385, children are two precursor molecules (the diene and the dienophile). Need to get SMILES of precursors by applying template? Could use apply_template tool with target and template_id to get precursors. Let's do that.
